title: Counterexamples to Written on the Wall II conjecture #138
description:
Explicit counterexamples to conjecture #138 of Written on the Wall II (Graffiti.pc): three trees on 18 vertices violate path(G) >= (2+u(G))*dist_min(M(G^2)); none exists with fewer vertices (exhaustive search over all unlabeled trees with 3-18 vertices). Includes self-contained verification script (Python standard library only), data, figures and a detailed note.

This repository is a public record of a personal AI-assisted exploration and makes no priority claim. The first witness (a 21-vertex tree) was derived with GPT 6.2 Astra (OpenAI Codex); see PROVENANCE.md.
